items.text: Danish toy production company Lego is investing more than $1 billion in a factory in the US. The factory is a part of a plan to shorten supply chains and compete with the demand in one of its biggest markets. Lego said that the 160,000-square-meter factory will be carbon neutral , and it’ll be located in Virginia. The investment is in line with the company’s strategy to place production close to its important markets and to avoid recent problems in the global retail industry. The plant is scheduled to be operational in the second part of 2025, and it’ll employ more than 1,760 people. The company employs around 24,000 people worldwide, and it produces around 100 billion colored bricks every year. Its sales grew 27% in 2021 to more than $8 billion. Difficult words: carbon neutral (companies or processes that balance the spread of carbon dioxide when they remove it from the environment), in line (in agreement with plans, rules, or policy), operational (ready to work). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Danish toymaker Lego is planning to build a new factory in the US. The factory will be in Virginia, and it is a part of the company’s plan to move toy creation closer to its biggest market . Recently, the global supply chain had many problems, and the cost of transportation increased, too. A factory in the US was a good way to lower the effects of global problems. The new factory will have 160,000 square meters, and it’ll give jobs to more than 1,760 people. Currently, it gives jobs to 24,000 people in all the world, and it makes around 100 billion colored bricks every year. Last year, the comany made more than $8 billion. Difficult words: market (a place or country, where people buy and sell things), supply chain (all the activities and the people which make products and send them to customers), global (all over the world). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Lego is a Danish company. It makes colored plastic bricks. It makes around 100 billion bricks every year. Lego is one of the biggest toymakers in the world. The company is building a new factory in Virginia, US. The factory will fix some problems. They are happening all over the world now. Transportation is very expensive. Many problems are in the supply chain. The supply chain is how a company sends things to customers. The new factory will open in 2025. It will have 160,000 square meters. 1,760 people will work there. 24,000 people work for Lego in all world. Difficult words: toymaker (a company which makes toys for children), transportation (a way to move someone or something from one place to another), customer (a person who buys things). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

For decades, African migrants have been risking their lives in overcrowded inflatable boats in the hope for a better life in Britain. However, this situation is about to change. Most migrants are young single men, and they arrive with the help of smugglers on boats or lorries. Many successfully apply for asylum; however, some never make it to the shore, and the government says that it needs to deter migrants from the dangerous and illegal routes into the country. A controversial five-year trial is now underway, and the trial means that some asylum seekers will be sent to Rwanda for processing after they reach British soil. However, Rwanda is one of the world’s least developed countries with a poor human rights record. The UK is one of other countries to process asylum seekers elsewhere. In 2001, Australia began using offshore detention centers in 2001, and in 2013, the country hardened its immigration law. Denmank introduced increasingly harsh immigration policies in the past 10 years. Last year, the country passed a law that allows refugees to be moved to asylum centers in its partner country. Difficult words: deter (to discourage someone), process (a method to officially document people), detention center (a place where people stay for a period of time). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The UK decided to stop migrants from coming to the country by boats. The journey is very dangerous and many people die on the way. Most migrants are young single men, and if they get to the UK, they usually get asylum and stay in the country. The British government wants to stop people from risking their lives. In the next five years, the country will send some migrants to Rwanda. In Rwanda, migrants will wait until officials work with them and their documents. Many people criticize this plan because Rwanda is a poor country with many problems, and migrants stay there in small rooms with only beds. The UK is one of other countries to send migrants to detention centers . For example, Australia and Denmark have strict immigration policies , and they send migrants to other countries, too. Difficult words: asylum (a safe place to stay), detention center (a place where illegal migrants stay until officials work with them and their documents), immigration policy (how a country deals with the people who come from other countries). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A migrant is a person. He moves from one country to another. Usually he moves because he is not safe in the first country. Many African migrants come to the UK by boats. The journey is very dangerous. Also, it is illegal . The boats are full. The sea is rough. Many people die. Young single men often come to the UK. Most of them can stay there. British politicians want to stop people who come by boats. The UK has a new plan. The country sends some migrants to Rwanda. Officials deal with their documents there. Many people are not happy with this plan. Rwanda is a poor country with many problems. Migrants also stay in small rooms. They only have a bed. Difficult words: illegal (against the rules of a country), single (a person who is not married or has no partner), deal with (to solve a situation or problem). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Disney hasn’t obtained permission to show its new Pixar movie ‘Lightyear’ in 14 countries in the Middle East and Asia, including Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Indonesia, Malaysia, and Lebanon. It has a depiction of a same-sex couple. Galyn Susman, the producer of the movie, said that Lightyear might not be able to open in China, either. The world’s largest movie market is there, and authorities asked for discounts that Disney declined to make. In many countries that outright banned the movie, homosexuality is a crime. The United Arab Emirates claimed that the movie violated its media content standards for movies. Lightyear debuts in the US and Canada on Friday, and it tells a story of young astronaut Buzz Lightyear. He tries to find a way back home after he is stranded on a hostile planet with his commander and crew. Difficult words: depiction (a representation of something in words or images), outright (immediately and completely), hostile (unfriendly or dangerous). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

‘Lightyear’ is a new movie by Pixar Animation Studios, and Disney delivers it other countries. It is about a young astronaut Buzz Lightyear. He is on a dangerous planet, and he tries to return home with his commander and other astronauts. 14 countries said that they wouldn’t show the movie, including Saudi Arabia, Indonesia, Malaysia, and Lebanon. The reason was the movie has a scene where two women kiss, and in some Muslim countries, homosexuality is a crime. China asked Disney to remove the scene, and Disney did, but then it put the scene in the movie again. The premiere of the movie is in the US and Canada on Friday. Difficult words: commander (a leader), homosexuality (a situation when a woman loves women and a man loves men), premiere (the first show of a film, play, and so on). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

American film studio Pixar makes a new movie. The name of the movie is ‘Lightyear’. It is about an astronaut. His name is Buzz Lightyear. Buzz, other astronauts, and their leader are on a dangerous planet. They try to go home. A woman kisses a woman in one scene of the movie. This scene is a problem for some people. Some countries say that they will not show the movie. For example, these countries are Saudi Arabia, Indonesia, and Malaysia. They are Muslim countries. They believe it is a crime when a woman loves another woman. Also, it is a crime when a man loves a man. China has a problem with the movie, too. China doesn’t want the scene in the movie. Disney removes the scene. Then it puts it back in. Difficult words: scene (one part of a movie, play, or book), crime (an act or situation, which is against the rules of a country), remove (to take something away). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

British journalist Dom Philips went missing in the Amazon last week. He vanished alongside indigenous affairs official Bruno Araujo Pereira, and Brazilian police are currently questioning a man over their disappearance. According to police, Mr. Pereira had received death threats just one week earlier after clashes with riverside communities over illegal fishing. The pair were reportedly last seen early in the São Rafael community in the Javari region. It is home to the most isolated indigenous people in the world. A vigil was held for the two men, and supporters and family members gathered outside the Brazilian Embassy in London, UK. They urged authorities to intensify the search, and Mr. Philips’s wife appealed to the authorities to take urgent action. Both men had extensive experience and knowledge of the region; however, time was a key factor in rescue operations, especially if the men were injured. Difficult words: vanish (to disappear suddenly and completely), clash (a violent conflict), vigil (a period of time when people remain quietly in a place, for example to pray or to make a political protest). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

British journalist Dom Philips and Brazilian official Bruno Araujo Pereira went missing last week. The two men disappeared in the Javari area, where some of the most isolated indigenous people in the world live. Phillips was in Brazil to research for his book about indigenous people. Police said that Pereira had a conflict over illegal fishing with some people who lived along a river. Only one week before he went missing, he received death threats . Police interviewed two people who saw the two men, but they didn’t arrest anyone. Meanwhile, people gathered outside the Brazilian Embassy in London, UK, and they asked officials to search for the men quickly. The Brazilian forest was dangerous, and every minute could decide if the men lived or died. Difficult words: isolated (far away from other places or people), indigenous (people who lived in a place before other people came to live there), death threat (a message that you will kill or hurt someone if he does or doesn’t do something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A British journalist and Brazilian official go missing last week. Last people see the two men in a boat in the Javari area. This area is far from any cities. Indigenous people live there. The journalist’s name is Dom Philips. He works on a book about indigenous people. Both men know the area very well. Police say that both men get death threats recently. This happens after a bad situation with some people near a river. Police say it is about illegal fishing. The men’s families ask officials to find the men quickly. The Amazon forest is a dangerous place. People meet in front the Brazilian Embassy in London, UK. They show that they care about the two men. Difficult words: indigenous (people who live in a place for a very long time), death threat (a message that you will kill or hurt someone), embassy (the building where officials of another country work). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Spain’s national meteorological office said that the country has been sweltering in the worst pre-summer heatwave for the past two decades. Scientists expect temperatures in parts of the west and south to reach 44 degrees Celsius. They also warn that heatwaves are becoming more frequent and beginning earlier. The global heat means that Spain’s summer begins between 20 and 40 days earlier than it did 50 years ago. With little time to acclimatize to normally midsummer temperatures, people are at higher risk of heatstroke, dizziness, and headaches. Meanwhile, fires in southern Spain forced almost 3,000 people to evacuate as the fires raged through mountainous regions near the city of Málaga. Various parts of Spain have regularly suffered wildfires over the past year. Difficult words: swelter (to be uncomfortably hot), acclimatize (to get used to a new climate or conditions), rage (to spread with strength and force).

An extreme heatwave hits Spain, and temperatures in the west and south of the country reached almost 44 degrees Celsius. Experts said that the heatwave was the worst pre-summer heatwave in the past 20 years. Heatwaves were more and more common, and they began earlier than in the past. Pre-summer heatwaves were dangerous for people because they had little time to get used to summer temperatures. People had more health problems, such as heatstroke, dizziness, or headache. Experts said that summer in Spain began 20 to 40 days earlier than it did 50 years ago. Due to the heat, more fires happened in Spain. Last week, almost 3,000 people left their homes in the southern part of the country. Difficult words: pre-summer (before summer), heatstroke (the situation if you get too hot), dizziness (the feeling that you may fall down). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The weather is very hot in Spain right now. The temperatures are almost 44 degrees Celsius. Heatwaves happen more and more often. This pre-summer heatwave is the worst in the past 20 years. It is a problem for people. They don’t have time to adapt to high temperatures. They feel sick and dizzy. They have a headache. Experts say that summer starts 20 to 40 days earlier than 50 years ago. Another problem is fires. The land is very dry. Fires happen often. Almost 3,000 people must leave their homes last week. A big fire is near the city of Málaga. Difficult words: heatwave (a longer period of time when the weather is much hotter than usual), pre-summer (something that happens before summer), frequent (happens often). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Celebrity suicides flood social media and the news. While mental health coverage is important, doctors say that they must be told with care to avoid suicide contagion . Suicide contagion happens when vulnerable individuals are exposed to too much detail about suicide in a film or news report. The exposure can lead to an increased risk of suicide. Young people are at particular risk because teens are more influenced by peer models and by what they see and hear. Young people have little experience of crises, and they don’t always understand that crises get better. According to doctors, some people think more in the abstract. They don’t want to live, but they don’t have active plans to die. However, when they see or hear too many details of a suicide, abstract thinking can become more real. Difficult words: coverage (a report about an issue by the media), contagion (an influence that spreads quickly), peer (a person of the same age, social position, or with the same abilities as other people in a group). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

People often share a lot of detail about suicide in media and films, and experts say that this detail can be dangerous for some people. Some people are not happy with their lives, and they think about death. They have no real plans to die. When they hear or read about a suicide, they start to think about ending their own life. This situation happens mainly to young people because they care about what other people think about them. They are under a lot or pressure from friends and other young people. Also, they don’t always understand they can get through difficult times in life. Experts warn that when media inform about a suicide repeatedly, the information is simplified . When people hear and read about a suicide, they start to think that it is the only solution to their problems. Difficult words: suicide (an action to end your own life), pressure (the influence or effect of someone or something), simplify (to make simpler or easier). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Suicide is an action when a person ends his own life. The media share many details about the suicides of celebrities . They speak about suicides again and again. Some people are not happy with their lives. They don’t know how to solve their problems. This situation is dangerous for teenagers. They want to be as good as others. They care about what their peers think about them. They don’t know that every difficult situation will be better one day. People hear information about a suicide very often. Then suicide seems it is the only way to solve problems. Some people think about suicide after they read or hear about it. Difficult words: media (TV, newspapers, Internet, and radio), celebrity (a famous person), peer (a person who is similar to someone else). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

At a candy factory in Pennsylvania, US, two men fell into a partially filled chocolate tank while they were doing maintenance work. The incident happened at the Mars Wrigley plant on Thursday at around 2 pm. The men worked for an outside contracting firm , and people weren’t sure how they fell into the tank. The chocolate in the tank was about waist-high, and the workers weren’t able to get out on their own. Emergency responders couldn’t pull the workers straight out of the tank, so they freed the men by cutting a hole in the side of the tank. Both men were then taken to hospital to be evaluated . However, officials didn’t provide any detail on their conditions. Authorities are investigating the incident, and they haven’t commented on it yet. Difficult words: maintenance (the work to keep a building or machinery in a good state), outside contracting firm (a company that works for other people or organizations), evaluate (to judge the quality of something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Two men fell into chocolate at a factory in Pennsylvania, US. The men weren’t employees of the factory, and they worked for another company. People weren’t sure how the incident happened. The men fell into a chocolate tank , and the chocolate was about waist -high. The men tried to get out, but it wasn’t possible. Emergency workers weren’t able to pull the men out, so they cut a hole in the side of the tank. The incident took place at around 2 pm, and it took one hour to get the men out. Then, they took both men to hospital. Authorities started to investigate how the men could fall in the chocolate, but they didn’t give any information about the situation yet. Difficult words: tank (a large container to keep or move gas, water, oil, or other things), waist (the part of the body between the chest and legs), investigate (to find out what happened and how). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Two men do maintenance work at candy factory in Pennsylvania, US. These men are not employees of the factory. They work for another company. The men fall into a tank full of chocolate. The chocolate is up to their waists . The men try to get out. It is not possible. Emergency workers come. They try to pull the men out. They can’t do it. They must put a hole in the tank. The work takes about one hour to get the men out. They go to hospital. Officials say that the men are not hurt. They now must find out how the men fall in the tank. Difficult words: maintenance work (the work to fix and care for machines and buildings), tank (a large container. Where people keep things like water, oil, gas, and so on), waist (the part of the body between the stomach and legs). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Typically, gun violence in the US surges in summer; however, after massacres in Texas, New York, and Oklahoma, city leaders in all of the country say that federal action is required. In the last two weeks, 13 mass shootings happened in cities across the US, with at least 17 people dead and dozens wounded. A research group describes a mass shooting as an incident with a minimum of four victims shot and wounded or killed, but excluding any shooter. However, that research group tracked nearly 300 shootings nationwide in one weekend. Just in Chicago, 33 people were shot and six of them killed. However, shootings are so frequent there that they aren’t big news. America has witnessed over 246 mass shootings this year, and this year is turning into one of the deadliest in history. Some states plan to arm teachers at schools to protect students, and these teachers will be trained to respond quickly in the case of a mass shooting. Difficult words: surge (to increase suddenly), massacre (the murder of a lot of people deliberately), arm (to provide someone with a weapon). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Two weeks ago, there were 13 mass shootings in US cities. At least 17 people died, and many others were hurt. A group of researchers watched these incidents and described a mass shooting. A mass shooting is when one or more attackers kill or hurt at least four people. On one weekend, 300 shootings happened in the US. In Chicago, attackers killed 33 people with guns. These attacks happened so often that the news didn’t share them. More mass shootings happen when summer comes, and this year, there already were almost 250 incidents . Some US states plan to deal with these incidents. They plan to give guns to teachers who will undergo special training to learn how to stop attackers in schools. Difficult words: mass (to affect a large number of people or things), incident (a memorable event), undergo (to experience something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section

Many mass shootings happen in the US. A mass shooting is when one or more attackers have a gun or guns. They kill or hurt at least four people with the guns. Two weeks ago, 13 mass shootings happen in the US in one weekend. The shootings happen in different states. On that weekend, nearly 300 other shootings happen in the country. The news don’t inform about some of the shootings. They happen too often. People want politicians to do something with the situation. In some states, politicians want to give guns to teachers. Teachers will get training . They will learn what to do if a mass shooting happens in their school. Difficult words: mass (to happen to many people or things), inform (to tell someone about something), training (when a person learns something so he can do a job or activity). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A drone flew in the skies above a chimpanzee enclosure at a zoo in the Netherlands, as it tried to take footage for a TV show. Program makers had hoped to capture the enclosure from above, but another camera caught the moment that a chimp hit the aircraft with a stick. It looked like it is not just humans who are concerned about their privacy. As the drone approached, the chimpanzee was perched on a branch. The chimp then lashed out with a stick and scored a direct hit. The aircraft fell to the ground and the chimpanzee wandered over for a closer look. Once the chimp got hold of the camera, it captured a video selfie. Difficult words: enclosure (an area with barriers such as walls or water to keep in animals), footage (video recording), perch (to sit on something narrow), lash (to hit quickly), score (to accomplish something), wander (to go but not knowing where you’re going). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

People are making a TV show in the Netherlands and they want video of a chimpanzee enclosure at a zoo. They send a drone with a camera over the enclosure, but a chimp that is sitting in a tree sees the drone flying by and knocks it down with a stick! Even though the drone falls to the ground, the camera continues to record. The same chimp climbs down to the drone and picks it up. It looks closely at the drone and the camera and looks like it is recording a video selfie . Difficult words: enclosure (an area with walls or other things to keep animals inside it), drone (a small unmanned aircraft), selfie (when someone records himself in a picture or a video). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

People make a TV show. They are in the Netherlands. They want video of a zoo. They want video of the chimpanzees at the zoo. They send a drone with a camera. It flies over the chimpanzees. A chimp sits in a tree. It sees the drone. The chimp has a stick. It hits the drone. The drone falls down. The camera still records video. The chimp comes to the drone. It picks it up. The chimp looks at the drone. It looks at the camera. Its face is very close to the camera! Difficult words: drone (a small plane that flies without a person), chimp (short for chimpanzee), record (to make a picture or video of something happening). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Police in the American state of Arizona thought that they were about to embark on a grim investigation when they received reports of human remains at the bottom of the Colorado River. On closer inspection, and much to the relief of emergency crews, the so-called remains were two fake skeletons enjoying a tea party. The discovery of the underwater bash came after officers received reports that a snorkeler had saw human bones, but they soon found the pair donning sunglasses and lounging in lawn chairs on the riverbed. One of the skeletons bore a sign reading, “ Bernie living the dream in the river.” Two divers later came forward to claim responsibility for creating the skeleton tea party. The pair placed the skeletons named Bernie and Bernadette in the river in August 2014 for their own amusement. The county lieutenant expressed hopes that the dive site will become a tourist attraction for the area. Difficult words: embark (begin), grim (serious), bash (a party), don (wear), lounge (lie in a relaxed way), bore (held onto), Bernie (this was a character who was dead during a comedy movie made in the 1980s), live the dream (feel very relaxed and happy), lieutenant (a police officer). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A person in Arizona was snorkelling in the Colorado River when he discovered something shocking – two human skeletons ! He called police to the site and found out that the skeletons were not real. What’s more, they were relaxing and enjoying a tea party. Two divers placed the skeletons Bernie and Bernadette in the river in August 2014. They did it for fun. The skeletons may bring more tourists to the area. Difficult words: snorkel (when you have your head under the water and breathe through a tube – a snorkel), skeleton (all of the bones in somebody’s body), site (a place where something special happened). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

This news is from Arizona, USA. Somebody snorkels in the Colorado River. The person finds something. It is two human skeletons ! The person calls the police. The police come. They look at the skeletons. They see that they are not real. Somebody put the skeletons into the water for fun. The skeletons even have names – Bernie and Bernadette. They may bring tourists to the area. Difficult words: snorkel (to swim with your head under the water and put a thing for breathing in your mouth – a snorkel), skeleton (all the bones in your body), may (can). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The sugar industry is the latest industry affected by the war in Ukraine and by supply chain issues. Producers worry that gas shortages may soon impact the global production of sugar. During the last three years, the demand of sugar has grown higher than production, and the stock of sugar has decreased in the world. Due to the war in Ukraine, sugar producers have lost some of the worldwide sugar beet harvest, and experts say the loss will bring a big supply problem for the whole world. Sugar beets are 32% of the world’s sugar supply, and the EU is the third largest sugar producer in the world. The manufacturing process uses a relatively large amount of energy for a short period of time, and most of this energy comes from coal, oil, or gas. Many factories fully depend on gas delivery, and they may soon have problems with processing sugar beets. That situation will be a disaster for beet growers and for the whole industry. Difficult words: supply chain (a network of people and organizations that are involved in getting a product to customers), sugar beet (a plant with a root that makes sugar), relatively (an unusual amount). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The war in Ukraine and several other problems are starting to affect the sugar industry. Ukraine is a very important producer of the sugar beet, a plant that people use to make sugar. When the war started, some farmers stopped harvesting sugar beet, which led to problems for sugar producers . During the last three years, the demand for sugar grew higher than its production, which means that sugar producers are running out of stock . The EU is the third largest sugar producer in the world, and many factories depend on gas. Sugar factories need a lot of energy, and the EU could soon have problems with gas supplies. If factories can’t create sugar, then farmers will have a huge problem. Difficult words: producer (a business that makes something), demand (a time when many people want something), stock (material or products which a company keeps to use or sell). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Problems are starting in the sugar business. One of the reasons is the war in Ukraine. Ukraine is one of the most important producers of sugar beet. The sugar beet is a plant. People use it to make sugar. Farmers in Ukraine stop harvesting the sugar beet. This is a problem for all the world. People need more and more sugar. Companies don’t have enough sugar in stock . Soon, sugar may be hard to find. It will be more expensive. The EU is the third largest producer of sugar. Some factories use coal or oil. Many factories need gas. The EU will stop buying gas from Russia. Factories may not buy sugar beet from farmer. Farmers will have problems, too. Difficult words: producer (a company or country which makes or grows something), harvest (to pick fruit and crops to eat), stock (material or things which a company uses or sells). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A 260-year-old Gold State Coach led a pageant through central London on Sunday. The coach was in footage of Queen Elizabeth II during her coronation in 1953. The ceremony last weekend was a part of Platinum Jubilee celebrations to mark the queen’s 70-year-rule in the UK. The golden carriage led the 5-kilometer parade that included around 6,000 performers, including pop singer Ed Sheeran. The procession followed a similar route to the one of the 96-year-old Queen on her coronation day, and it aimed to remind the different decades of her reign. The Queen missed several jubilee events because of mobility issues, and she wasn’t in the carriage either. She opted to have a film from 1953 sit in her place. The Queen appeared as a hologram waving to the crowds, making it seem as if she was inside. Difficult words: coronation (a ceremony of the beginning of a king or queen), pageant (a big public ceremony), opt (to make a choice). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Last weekend, the British celebrated 70 years of the rule of Queen Elizabeth II, and they held a ceremony in central London. A 260-year-old gold carriage led the parade , which was almost five kilometers long. The Queen can’t walk well recently, so she didn’t take part at some events during the celebrations. She wasn’t inside the carriage, but people could see a hologram of her during her coronation in 1953. She waved to people, and it seemed as if she was really inside. Around 6,000 people performed at the parade, including British pop singer Ed Sheeran. Difficult words: parade (a movement of people or vehicles through a public place to celebrate an important day or event), coronation (a celebration for the beginning of a king or queen), hologram (a special 3D image). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Queen Elizabeth II is the queen of Britain. She is in this job for 70 years. Last weekend, people have a big ceremony in central London. A parade moves through the city. It is almost 5 kilometers long. 6,000 people are in the parade. Some singers are there, too. One is Ed Sheeran. A gold carriage is at the beginning of the parade. It is 260 years old. In 1953, Queen Elizabeth sits in the carriage. This time, the Queen isn’t in the carriage. People can see only her image. It looks as if she is sitting inside. The Queen doesn’t attend all of the ceremony. She can’t move well. Difficult words: ceremony (a special event to remember something), parade (an event when people or vehicles through a public place to remember something), carriage (a vehicle that moves when horses pull it). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Last week, thousands of people marched against femicide and gender violence in Argentina’s capital of Buenos Aires. The protest was part of a movement called ‘Ni Una Menos’ or ‘Not One Woman Less’. The march culminated at the National Congress, where protesters lit candles to remember victims of gender-based violence. According to reports, one femicide was recorded every 35 hours in the country last year, and 81% of women killed were victims of domestic violence. Many of the murdered women previously made claims with the police; however they weren’t listened to. According to one protester, Argentinian justice was slow and patriarchal , and politicians have no clear answers to the violence. Difficult words: femicide (the murder of a woman or girl because of her gender), culminate (to end or arrive at the final stage), patriarchal (a system of society or government that men control). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Last week, women in Argentina’s capital of Buenos Aires protested against femicide and gender violence . Thousands of people walked through the streets of the city. When they reached the National Congress, they lit candles for women who died from femicide and gender violence. Many of those women had told police that they had problems. Sadly, the police didn’t listen to these women, and later, men killed them. Reports said that last year, one femicide happened every 35 hours in Argentina. 81% of these women died because of domestic violence. Many women complained that the police were slow and that officials didn’t listen to women. They said that politicians did nothing to stop the violence. Difficult words: femicide (the murder of a woman because she is a woman), gender violence (the actions to hurt a man or a woman because they are a man or woman), domestic (in the home). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Women in Argentina protest. They don’t like the femicide and gender violence there. Femicide is an attack on a girl or woman because she is a woman. Gender violence is an attack on a man or woman only because they are a man or woman. Last year, femicide happens every 35 hours in Argentina. Most of these women die because of domestic violence. This violence means their partners or husbands kill them. Women in Argentina say that police don’t care. Many women tell the police about their problems. The police do nothing. Politicians also do nothing. Difficult words: gender (the situation to be a man or woman), violence (attacks on other people), domestic (in the home or family). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A rare albino Galapagos giant tortoise has debuted at a Swiss zoo. The success rate of babies for Galapagos tortoises is extremely low. Last month, two tortoises were born at the zoo as a part of a program to preserve endangered species. One tortoise was black, like its parents, and the other was albino. The staff waited for two days to be sure it would be albino. After several months of incubation , the staff had the chance to see the hatching which was the zoo’s second hatching. Everyone was surprised by the tortoise’s color because it was very unusual for this species. The chance of an albino tortoise that is about one in 100,000. Albinism is the absence of color in an animal, plant, or person and results in white hair, feathers, and skin and pink eyes. Albinism can decrease the chance of survival due to the lack of protection from UV radiation and the camouflage to avoid predators. Difficult words: albino (a person or animal that doesn’t have pigment in the skin, hair, or feathers), incubation (the time that a bird or other animal that keeps its eggs warm until the young hatch), camouflage (the ability of an animal to try to look the same as its surroundings to hide). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Albinism is a special condition when a person, animal, or plant has no pigment . As a result, the animals have white feathers or skin and pink eyes. People usually have white hair and skin. Albinism can be dangerous for animals because their skin can’t protect them from sunshine, and they are also more visible for other animals. Last month, two tortoises were born at a Swiss zoo. One tortoise was black, and the other was albino . The staff waited two days before they were sure that the tortoise was albino. Albinism is very unusual for tortoises, and only one in about 100,000 animals was albino. Difficult words: pigment (the color in the skin or other body parts), visible (the area that others can see something or someone), albino (a person or animal who has albinism). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Albinism means that a person or animal has no pigment. Pigment is a thing which makes the color in our hair and skin. Albino people usually have white hair and skin. Albino animals have white hair or feathers . They usually have red eyes, too. Albinism can be dangerous for animals. Pigment keeps them safe from the sunshine. Albino animals can’t hide easily from predators . Two Galapagos tortoises are born at a Swiss zoo. This situation doesn’t happen very often. People at the zoo are very happy. One tortoise is black. One is albino. The chance of an albino tortoise is one in 100,000. Difficult words: albino (a person or animal with albinism), feather (one of many soft, light things, which cover a bird’s body), predator (an animal which eats other animals). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Chicken is the most consumed meat in the world; however, it’s more expensive than ever. So why is chicken getting so expensive? Ukraine is a major producer of corn and wheat, the main feed source for chicken. The war in Ukraine has upended this situation because it caused prices to increase to feed and care for chickens. Besides the war, bird flu has occurred in important producing regions. As a result, farmers slaughtered millions of birds to stop the spread of flu. In the US alone, farmers killed over 38 million chickens and turkeys since February. As global prices rise, countries are safeguarding domestic supplies. In an extreme example, Malaysia stopped chicken exports from June 1st to ease the food price costs and safeguard their domestic supplies. Chicken’s affordability made it the world’s meat of choice; however, it may become as expensive as beef. Difficult words: upend (to turn something upside down), safeguard (to protect from harm or loss), domestic (for an individual country). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The global price of chicken is growing due to many reasons. Ukraine is the biggest grower of corn and wheat, which is used to feed chicken. When the war in Ukraine started, it couldn’t export corn and wheat; then chicken feed became much more expensive. Another problem was bird flu happened in the main chicken countries like the US and UK. Since February in the US, farmers killed more than 38 million chickens and turkeys. As the prices of chicken grow, countries want to save enough chicken for themselves. Some countries stopped chicken exports, but then the prices grew even more. In the past, chicken was very cheap, which is why it became so popular everywhere. Now, maybe it’ll cost as much as beef . Difficult words: global (across the whole world), export (to sell things to another country), beef (cow’s meat). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

For many years, chicken is very cheap meat. Then it becomes popular in all the world. Now the situation is changing. Ukraine is one of the biggest producers of corn and wheat. Farmers feed chickens with corn and wheat. When the war starts, farmers have no corn and wheat. Then the price of chicken starts to grow. Another reason for high prices is bird flu. It is a serious disease for birds. Farmers must kill millions of chickens and turkeys. They want to stop the disease. The price grows. Some countries stop chicken exports . It makes new problems. Chicken may soon be as expensive as beef . Difficult words: producer (a person or company to make something and then sell it), export (to sell things to another country), beef (cow’s meat). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

EU leaders agreed to pursue a partial ban on Russian oil. The ban may begin a sixth package of sanctions as punishment on Russia for the Ukraine invasion. The sanctions forbid the purchase of oil and petroleum products from Russia, which they deliver to the EU by sea. However, the sanctions allow a temporary exemption for pipeline oil. The ban immediately covers more than 60% of Russian oil imports. It cuts a huge source of war funding, and it puts maximum pressure on Russia to end the war. Ursula von der Leyen, president of the European Commission, said that thanks to the latest package of sanctions, the EU should complete a ban on almost 90% of all Russian oil imports by the end of the year. Other important parts in the package are the exclusion of Sberbank, the biggest Russian bank, from the global payment system. It also puts a ban on insurance and reinsurance of Russian ships by EU companies. The EU has additionally banned access for Russian companies to a range of business services, and it has suspended three Russian state media from broadcasting in the EU. Difficult words: pursue (to follow), exemption (an exception), suspend (to stop activity). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

EU leaders agreed to ban more than 60% of oil from Russia to the EU. The sixth sanctions package makes it impossible to import oil by sea, but Russia will still be able to import oil through pipes. The European Commission president said that the EU will ban 90% of Russian oil by the end of the year. EU leaders believe that it will force Russia to end the war in Ukraine because Russia uses the money from oil to pay for the war. The EU will also exclude the biggest Russian bank from the global payment system, and it won’t be possible to do some business services for Russian companies. Difficult words: sanction (an action which forces a country to follow international laws), import (to buy something from another country), exclude (to stop or block). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

EU leaders agree on more sanctions against Russia. They hope that the sanctions will make Russia stop the Ukraine. Russia needs money for the war. Russia sells oil to the EU. The EU must not buy oil from Russia. They will buy no Russian oil by sea. The only exception now is the oil in pipes. The EU wants to ban 90% of Russian oil by the end of this year. The EU will not let the biggest Russian bank in the global bank system. Also, they won’t let other countries do business with Russian companies. Another important rule is the EU blocks three Russian state media . They normally send news to the EU. Difficult words: sanction (an action to make a country follow rules), exception (something that is outside of the rules), broadcast (to send by radio, Internet, or television). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In Las Vegas, a golden retriever named Benny wore ice skates on his front paws so that he could play in an ice-skating rink. His tail was wagging , so he was enjoying this as he ran around. He even slid in between two traffic cones to pick up a hockey stick with his mouth. Difficult words: paw (an animal’s foot), wag (move quickly from side to side), traffic cone (orange objects with triangular tops and circular bottoms that people use to show where work is happening in the street; traffic cones move smoothly on ice). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In Las Vegas, a dog named Benny wore ice skates on his front paws . He could run in an ice-skating rink. His tail was wagging , so he was happy as he ran around. He later slid in between two traffic cones to pick up a hockey stick in his mouth. Difficult words: paw (an animal’s foot), wag (move from side to side), traffic cone (orange things with triangular tops and circular bottoms that show where work is happening in the street; traffic cones move well on ice). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

This is in Las Vegas. There is an ice-skating rink . A dog named Benny goes to the rink. He wears ice skates on his front paws . He goes on the ice! Benny is very happy on the ice. He runs around. He slides between two traffic cones . He picks up a hockey stick. Difficult words: ice skating rink (a place where people put ice so that they can ice skate or play a winter sport), paw (an animal’s foot), traffic cone (orange things with triangular tops and circular bottoms; people use them on roads and streets, but they also move well on ice). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

24-year-old Franziska Trautman is called the sand girl on TikTok because she’s trying to restore Louisiana’s eroding coastline with glass sand. Franziska was disappointed with the lack of glass recycling facilities in her state, so she co-founded the first and only facility in Louisiana, US. She realized that glass can be changed into sand, and the glass could help with the coastal erosion crisis. Franziska and her friend launched a GoFundMe campaign to raise money to purchase their first glass recycling machine. So far, the facility has diverted almost one million kilograms of glass from landfills into sand. Machines crush the glass and take out the labels, metal pieces, and the non-glass particles. The result is a mixture of glass, sand, and gravel which she uses for disaster relief sandbags, coastal restoration, or flooring. After water, sand is the second globally exploited resource, and people use it at twice the rate that nature creates it. Difficult words: erode (to be destroyed gradually), gravel (very small, rounded stones often mixed with sand), exploit (to use of something to make a profit). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Franziska Trautman and her friend knew nothing about recycling . They knew that the coastline eroded in Louisiana, US, and they created an idea to improve the situation. They thought that they could recycle glass and turn it into sand, but they learned that no places in Louisiana recycled glass. All the glass ended up in landfills . The two young people raised money, and they bought the first recycling machine in the state. The machine crushes the glass and removes pieces of metal, paper, and plastics. A mixture of glass, sand, and very small stones comes from the machine. People can use the mixture for sandbags, floors, or to help the coast. Franziska said that people used too much sand, and they used it faster than nature could create it. Difficult words: recycle (to make new things from something that people put in the trash), erode (to be destroyed slowly), landfill (a deep hole where people throw things that they don’t need anymore). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Franziska Trautman and her friend are college students. They are from Louisiana, US. They are similar up many young people. The natural world worries them. They worry about that the coast is eroding . Franziska and her friend get an idea. They want to recycle glass bottles. They want to make sand from them. They learn there is no place in Louisiana which recycles glass. They must buy a machine. They have no money. They get money from people. They get a machine. It breaks glass into small pieces. The machine takes out metal, plastic, and paper. People use the sand for sandbags, floors, or for help on the coast. People use too much sand. Nature can’t make enough sand. Sand from bottles can help solve this problem. Difficult words: erode (to get worse and worse), recycle (to make new things from things which people don’t use anymore), sandbag (a bag full of sand, which people use to stop something like water). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A pet python named Winston underwent surgery to remove a pair of barbecue tongs that he had swallowed. Snakes have an ability to regurgitate food if they change their mind on what they ate, but vets at Adelaide University in Australia were not convinced that Winston was going to regurgitate even if he tried, so they operated on the python. The snake drama unfolded when Winston’s owner used the tongs to feed a dead rat to him, which he then gripped on to. The owner was unable to free the tongs, so he left them with Winston only to return later to find that the snake had swallowed them whole. Vets reported that the pet will make a good recovery. Difficult words: python (a large snake which has no venom – venom Is a poison), tongs (a tool that you use to lift up small things), regurgitate (bring back food), unfold (happen). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A man from Australia has a pet snake called Winston. One time, the owner used barbecue tongs to feed a rat to the snake. The snake gripped on to the tongs as well, and the man could not take the tongs from him. The owner left the tongs with Winston. When he returned, the tongs were gone – Winston ate them. Snakes can bring back food which they don’t like, but tongs could hurt the snake. The pet snake had to have an operation – doctors removed the tongs and Winston is getting better. Difficult words: owner (a person who owns – has something), barbecue tongs (a thing which you use to lift meat on the barbecue), grip (to take and hold something tightly). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A man from Australia has a snake. He feeds it a rat . He holds the rat with tongs . The snake eats the tongs, too. This is dangerous for the snake. Doctors operate on it. They take out the tongs. The snake’s name is Winston. He is getting better. Difficult words: feed (to give food to an animal), rat (a small animal), tongs (a thing for taking small things like a piece of meat on the barbecue). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Due to the Ukraine war, the prices of commodities increase, and agencies say that providing help for Africa is becoming too expensive. According to officials, the worst issue for Somalia is a drought from the changing climate; also, the Ukraine crisis means that the country needs more resources. UNICEF spends $137 million a year on therapeutic food there. Over the past year, the cost of it has risen by 23%, and the Ukraine conflict has created an international food crisis. According to Nutriset, the company that provides therapeutic food, the cost of ingredients such as palm oil, milk powder and whey increased sharply, and shipping expenses have also rose. Aid agencies say that the problem for Africa’s countries has intensified, as donor countries send money to help Ukraine’s refugees. Without further funding, 600,000 more children may lose treatment. Difficult words: commodity (a raw material or a product of agriculture), therapeutic food (food that’s rich in nutrients, and it’s used to treat sick children who have little food), donor (someone who donates something, especially money to charity). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Organizations help people in Africa; they are saying that the help is becoming very expensive. Somalia is a country badly affected by drought , and it needs a lot of help. Sadly, international organizations have big problems, and the reason is the war in Ukraine. These organizations must help Ukrainian refugees , and they have less money to give to people in Africa. Nutriset is a French company, which makes food for African children. This special food contains peanuts, palm oil, milk powder , and other things which are becoming more expensive. Since last year, the price of this food went up by 23%. Organizations say that they need more money. Without the money, 600,000 more children won’t have enough food. Difficult words: drought (a long period without rain), refugee (a person that leaves his country because of danger), milk powder (dry milk). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

International organizations help people in Africa. They give people food. Sadly, this help is becoming expensive now. The problem is the war in Ukraine. The war is making food more expensive. A French company makes special food for African children. It contains peanuts, oil, dry milk, and other things. All these things are more expensive. The price of this food goes up by 23% since last year. Another problem is that organizations must to help Ukrainian refugees . Their help means that they have less money for food for African children. The organizations say that they need more money. Without money, more children won’t have enough food. Difficult words: international (something that comes from different countries), contain (to have a part of something), refugee (a person who leaves a country because of danger). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.
